clue.text: Do it in a new fashion throughout the land

indicators.note: to fashion is to shape or form anew, so the preceding letters are remade into another order

explanation.surface: An instruction to carry out some task in a novel way across the whole country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fashion' tells you to rearrange DOITINANEW, all the letters of 'Do it in a new'.
explanation.definitionFit: Something nationwide extends across every part of the country.

clue.text: The master of a boat carrying livestock

definitions.text: The master of a boat carrying livestock

parts.words: The master of a boat carrying livestock
parts.note: read plainly a cattle-ship captain, but meant as the Bible's patriarch who loaded the ark with animals two by two

explanation.surface: A description of the skipper of a cattle transport vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis this patriarch built the ark and captained it with pairs of every animal aboard.

clue.text: The ordinary quality interests odd characters

indicators.note: the letters are treated as strange, out-of-place characters, so they are shuffled into a new word

explanation.surface: Someone finds that what is commonplace holds a curious appeal for eccentric people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'odd characters' signals an anagram of the nine letters of INTERESTS.
explanation.definitionFit: Triteness is the state of being hackneyed and commonplace, an ordinary, stale quality.

clue.text: Warning signs printed in women's magazines

indicators.note: the letters sit printed within the word that follows, so the run is found inside it

explanation.surface: Notices of danger appear in the pages of magazines aimed at women.
explanation.walkthrough: 'printed in' points to a run inside 'women's', ignoring the apostrophe; 'magazines' merely completes the picture.
explanation.definitionFit: Omens are portents, signs taken to foretell trouble.

clue.text: Having a point, phoned the French to argue

parts.note: W, west, is a point of the compass
rang means telephoned
le is French for 'the'

explanation.surface: Someone with a point to make telephones the French to have a quarrel.
explanation.definitionFit: To wrangle is to dispute noisily or at length.

clue.text: Put down petty officers indeed!

indicators.note: the word 'indeed' is split, so 'in' tells you the officers go inside the remaining 'deed'

parts.note: taken as written
PO is the naval abbreviation for petty officer, here plural POS

explanation.surface: An exclamation of surprise that petty officers have been demoted.
explanation.walkthrough: The trick is to read 'indeed' as 'in deed': POS placed in DEED.
explanation.definitionFit: To depose is to remove from office, to bring down a ruler.

clue.text: I'd return to Virginia, a prima donna

indicators.note: to return is to come back, so the letters of I'd are read from the end

parts.note: the letters I and D, apostrophe ignored
VA is the abbreviation for the US state of Virginia

explanation.surface: Someone vows to go back to Virginia, perhaps like a temperamental opera star.
explanation.definitionFit: A diva is a celebrated female opera singer, the leading lady of the company.

clue.text: I, a graduate, turn to the last stage of insect life

definitions.text: the last stage of insect life

parts.note: MA, Master of Arts, is a graduate
a go is a turn in a game

explanation.surface: A graduate reflects on turning to entomology's final phase.
explanation.definitionFit: The imago is the mature winged adult form an insect reaches after metamorphosis.

clue.text: The earl got totally confused

indicators.note: confused letters are jumbled out of order, so these words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A nobleman became thoroughly muddled.
explanation.definitionFit: Altogether is an adverb meaning completely, wholly.

clue.text: Excuse offered with certain enjoyment

parts.note: a plea is an excuse offered in defence
sure means certain

explanation.surface: An apology is made with a confident air of delight.
explanation.definitionFit: Pleasure is delight or gratification.

clue.text: Quick drink taken about four

indicators.note: the drink is placed around the number, so it is wrapped about the other piece

parts.note: ale is a drink, beer
IV is four in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A fast drink is downed, around four o'clock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Quick' is the old sense of living, as in 'the quick and the dead'.
explanation.definitionFit: Quick in its archaic sense means living, not dead.

clue.text: An appealing individual!

parts.note: suggests a charming person, but means someone who lodges a legal appeal to a higher court

explanation.surface: A remark about someone with great charm.
explanation.definitionFit: An appellant is the party who appeals against a court's decision.

clue.text: Reports made of disorder without authority

indicators.note: in its old sense of outside, so the disorder wraps around the other piece

parts.note: a mess is a state of disorder
a sage is a wise authority, an expert

explanation.surface: News bulletins compiled in chaos, with nobody in charge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' here means outside, not lacking: SAGE goes inside MESS.
explanation.definitionFit: Messages are communications, items of news passed on.

clue.text: Beside a pine

parts.note: to pine is to long, to yearn

explanation.surface: Next to a conifer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pine' looks like the tree but is the verb, to long for.
explanation.definitionFit: Along can mean alongside, by the side of.

clue.text: Opposing some players, though it's forbidden

parts.note: contra means against, opposing
a band is a group of musical players

explanation.surface: Being against certain musicians, even though it is banned.
explanation.definitionFit: Contraband goods are prohibited, smuggled illegally.

clue.text: Love poetry written by egghead boss

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, O
verse is poetry
the head of 'egg', its first letter

explanation.surface: Love verses composed by an intellectual for the person in charge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'egghead' is not an intellectual but the head of 'egg', its first letter E.
explanation.definitionFit: To boss, as a verb, is to supervise, direct and manage.

clue.text: Disturbing carol-the content's bitter

indicators.note: what follows is the contents, the filling, of the carol

parts.note: to carol is to sing
tart means sour or bitter

explanation.surface: A disquieting carol whose message is a bitter one.
explanation.walkthrough: Starting in the sense of giving a start, startling; 'the content's' puts TART inside SING.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that makes you start, jump with alarm, is upsetting or unsettling.

clue.text: The old-fashioned wear two casual shirts together

parts.note: double means twice, two of
a T-shirt is a casual shirt, giving the letter T

explanation.surface: Wearing two casual tops at once.
explanation.walkthrough: Two T-shirts together make a 'double T'.
explanation.definitionFit: A doublet was a close-fitting jacket worn by men from the 14th to 17th centuries.

clue.text: Prepared hot meals include nothing dislikable

indicators.note: the rearranged letters take in the zero, so it goes inside them
meals that are prepared are made up, so the letters are put together afresh

parts.note: O, zero, is nothing

explanation.surface: Cooked hot dishes that contain nothing appetising.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Prepared' rearranges HOTMEALS to LATHSOME; 'include' puts O inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Loathsome means hateful, causing disgust.

clue.text: Willing to experiment, tucked in

parts.note: a test is an experiment
to tuck in is to eat heartily, so ate

explanation.surface: Someone keen to try something new and then eat heartily.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Willing' is not eager but having made a will.
explanation.definitionFit: A testate person died leaving a valid will.

clue.text: Do out of a note with cunning

parts.note: ex means out of, from
E is a musical note
cute can mean shrewd or cunning

explanation.surface: To cheat someone out of money with a slyly written note.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Do out of' reads as cheat, but 'Do' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To execute a task is to carry it out, perform it.

clue.text: An ecclesiastic head round about fifty

indicators.note: the head goes round the other letters, enclosing them

parts.note: pate is the head
re means about, concerning
L is fifty in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A churchman's head becomes rounded at about fifty.
explanation.definitionFit: A prelate is a high-ranking churchman such as a bishop.

clue.text: To show this is a real giveaway

explanation.surface: Something revealing is a genuine free gift.
explanation.definitionFit: To present is to display or exhibit; a present is a gift, something given away.

clue.text: The annual check-up on the house

definitions.text: The annual check-up on the house

parts.words: The annual check-up on the house
parts.note: sounds like a free medical, 'on the house', but means a yearly inspection of a firm's books

explanation.surface: A yearly medical examination offered free.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On the house' means free, but here it is a business house, a firm.
explanation.definitionFit: An audit is the official yearly inspection of an organisation's accounts.

clue.text: The bad spirit that makes many obnoxious

parts.note: D is 500 in Roman numerals, a large number
evil means wicked, obnoxious

explanation.surface: A wicked spirit that makes many people unpleasant.
explanation.definitionFit: The devil is a malevolent spirit, Satan.

clue.text: Seeing a team rowing about agreement

indicators.note: the rowing team goes round the agreement, placed about it

parts.note: an eight is a rowing crew
yes expresses agreement

explanation.surface: Watching a rowing crew negotiate a deal.
explanation.definitionFit: Eyesight is the faculty of vision.

clue.text: Broadcast for children

explanation.surface: A transmission meant for youngsters.
explanation.definitionFit: To issue is to put out or publish; issue also means offspring.

clue.text: Measures people may take a stand on

definitions.text: people may take a stand on

explanation.surface: Steps people take when making a principled stand.
explanation.definitionFit: A foot is a unit of length of twelve inches; people stand on their lower limbs' ends.

clue.text: Risk coming by water

parts.note: an advent is an arrival, a coming
the Ure is a river in Yorkshire

explanation.surface: Danger arriving by sea.
explanation.walkthrough: The URE is a river in North Yorkshire, England.
explanation.definitionFit: An adventure is a risky undertaking, a hazardous venture.

clue.text: A monument-one at the road-side

parts.note: ST, street, a road, which goes at the side, ahead of the number
taken as written

explanation.surface: A memorial set up at the roadside.
explanation.definitionFit: A stone can be a memorial, such as a headstone or standing stone.

clue.text: He never thinks he'll get told off

indicators.note: something off is spoiled or out of place, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone thoughtless is going to be scolded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'told off' looks like scolded; 'off' is the anagram indicator acting on TOLD.
explanation.definitionFit: A dolt is a stupid person, one who does not think.

clue.text: Community charge payment

definitions.meaning: a place where people have settled
the paying of what is owed

explanation.surface: A payment of the local council tax.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface recalls the Community Charge, the British poll tax of 1990-93.
explanation.definitionFit: A settlement is a village or colony; a settlement is also the paying off of a bill.
